		text = zin_lastwar.10.d_sun
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_heeded }
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_lastwar.10.d
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_heeded }
			}
		}

# The King of the East Marches West
# to: news: every country; hist: Ironfrost 1758
news_event = {
	id = zin_lastwar.90
	title = zin_lastwar.90.t
	desc = zin_lastwar.90.d
	picture = GFX_zin_news_beat_crowns_eastern_news
	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.90.a
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.90.b
		trigger = {
			AND = {
				is_subject = yes
				OVERLORD = {
					OR = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.90.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					is_subject = yes
					OVERLORD = {
						OR = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}

# The Claim of All Aoaz
# to: every great power that is not the Worshipdom or its subject; hist: 1758
country_event = {
	id = zin_lastwar.91
	title = zin_lastwar.91.t
	desc = zin_lastwar.91.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_crowns_eastern_court
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.91.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_lastwar.91.a_tip
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
			}
			ROOT = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_lastwar_refused_the_claim }
			}
		}
		add_war_support = 0.05
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.91.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.91.c
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { zin_footholds > 3.999 }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_lastwar.91.c_tip
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
			}
			ROOT = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_lastwar_recognised_the_claim }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		}
	}
}

# Envoys to the Coronation
# to: every coalition member; every great power not at war with the Host; the Free Dominions; hist: Thaw 1760
country_event = {
	id = zin_lastwar.113
	title = zin_lastwar.113.t
	desc = zin_lastwar.113.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_crowns_coronation
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.113.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 45
				check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > -0.001 }
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_lastwar.113.a_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			zin_aenor_event_for_parim = yes
		}
		event_target:zin_aenor_parim_realm = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_lastwar_coronation_envoy }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.113.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lastwar.113.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_lastwar.113.c_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			zin_aenor_event_for_parim = yes
		}
		event_target:zin_aenor_parim_realm = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_lastwar_coronation_snub }
		}
	}
}
